description: This file defines the Operations class with static methods for performing arithmetic operations (add, divide, multiply, subtract) on complex numbers, including validation and handling of complex number suffixes.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: A class providing static methods for arithmetic operations on complex numbers.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two or more complex numbers, returning a Complex object.

methods.name: divideby
methods.description: Divides the first complex number by subsequent ones, returning a Complex object.

methods.name: divideinto
methods.description: Divides subsequent complex numbers into the first one, returning a Complex object.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies two or more complex numbers, returning a Complex object.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts multiple complex numbers from the first, returning a Complex object.
